CARES

CARES (Comprehensive Assessment & Risk Evaluation Service) is a cybersecurity platform designed around the product vision in docs/CARES_PRODUCT_VISION.md.

This repository currently contains a small, in-memory Python prototype. It is not an operational platform. PostgreSQL, secure tenant isolation, an external AI provider, API, Dashboard, Agent, and event processing are not implemented.

Prototype behavior

  • A repeated caller-provided identity maps to one in-memory asset within one process.
  • A simple access predicate compares tenant IDs and roles; it is not an authentication or tenant-isolation boundary.
  • A local AI policy helper reports status but does not call an AI provider or transmit data.

These behaviors have narrow unit-test coverage only. See docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md for limitations and proposed design.

Run the prototype tests

python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q
